title: Streaming connection lease and graceful-cancel guidance for Go SDK
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design, implement, and document a robust connection-lease and graceful cancellation model for the Go SDK streaming client. The ticket covers protocol-level lease semantics, client-side lease refresh/backoff heuristics, interaction with context cancellations and timeouts, and user-facing examples demonstrating correct patterns for long-running and intermittently flaky networks.
acceptance_criteria: Go SDK exposes a clear connection lease API that can be used by higher-level stream helpers (LeaseAcquire, LeaseRefresh, LeaseRelease).
Client cancels active streams without leaking goroutines or leaving server-side leases pinned when context cancellation occurs.
Default lease refresh/backoff heuristics chosen for hosted and dedicated modes with config override.
Unit and integration tests covering cancellation races, lease expiry, and reconnect windows.
Updated Go SDK docs and two short examples: (1) long-polling generator with cooperative cancel, (2) resumable stream with lease-backed prefetch.
comments: 2026-03-10 | Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created after post-mortem for intermittent client-side goroutine leaks during tenant demo. Observed leases kept alive for ~30s after client Cancel. Intention: explicit lease lifecycle + SDK helpers.

2026-03-11 | Miguel Santos: PoC implemented: Lease object holds context, refresh loop stops on Release() and on refresh error. Found race when Release() called concurrently with refresh callback; added channel handshake to sequence shutdown.

2026-03-12 | Lina Chen (review): Asked whether lease should be automatically renewed when user uses Resume() vs kept owned by caller. Recommendation: SDK should provide both a low-level lease primitive and a higher-level StreamManager that automates renewals for resumable streams.

2026-03-12 | Miguel Santos: Trade-off discussion — aggressive renew (low latency on reconnect) increases RPCs and cost; conservative renew risks expired KV cache on server and extra cold-token cost. Chosen default: jittered renew at 60% of lease TTL with exponential backoff on transient failures, configurable via StreamConfig.RenewWindowPct and RetryPolicy.

2026-03-13 | PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/412 'streaming: add lease primitive and graceful cancel helpers'. Includes unit tests for concurrent Release+Refresh and cancel propagation. CI failing on flaky integration test (race with test harness deadline).

2026-03-13 | DevOps: Added integration run that repros lease expiry behavior against dedicated staging. Observed expected behavior when TTL=10s and renew at 6s; clients resumed successfully after reconnect window. Added follow-up to tighten test harness timing.

2026-03-14 | Product: Requested two examples for docs: cooperative cancellation with context.WithTimeout and resumable stream with lease checkpointing. Marked UX docs as a release blocker for go-sdk-2.4.0.
